title: Specialized Surface Bindings & Skin Laboratory Runtime
objective: Implement presentation-only specialized game-surface recipe bindings plus the Skin Laboratory/evidence harness over the completed UISR-01..04 runtime foundations.

included: specialized presentation recipe bindings for spatial/tactical, relational, randomizer, resource/timing, inventory, temporal, data-visualization and trust/authority surfaces
protected semantic and hidden-information-safe bindings for maps, graphs, dice, inventory/equipment, timelines/logs, charts and AI/provenance/permission/validation surfaces
specialized-surface accessibility, fallback and deterministic-variation behavior

Skin Laboratory runtime with shared control rail, component/state gallery, typography lab, specialized-surface fixtures, responsive/accessibility profiles, deterministic Patchwork seed controls and diagnostics
focused UISR-05 tests and cross-platform exact-head validation
excluded: Ember/Chromatic migration, gallery, assignment and persistence reserved for UISR-06
full target-skin materialization reserved for UISR-07 through UISR-09
packaging, Tier-C validation, performance proof and legacy cleanup reserved for UISR-10
gameplay, permission, hidden-information, navigation, validation, provenance or AI authority
scope.completion_gate: Specialized game surfaces resolve through presentation-only recipes with protected semantics/accessibility intact, and Skin Laboratory can deterministically exercise shared and specialized presentation states without becoming application authority.

selection_boundaries: UISR-05 is selected by verified UISR-04 closeout but has no implementation authority until a later owner Continue.
The ui-implementation lane remains parallel to product-development and may not pause or rewrite product work.
Publication to Multiversal-app main remains serialized by the existing merge lease and requires fresh-base reconciliation if another lane publishes first.
next_action: No UISR-05 work remains. UISR-06 is selected_not_started and requires a later owner Continue for governed start.

tdd.red_decisive_failure: Public UISR-05 runtime API was absent; focused tests asserted resolveSpecializedSurfacePresentation and related Skin Laboratory functions were not exported.

roadmap_reconciliation.rationale: No UISR program node or cross-program milestone gate supersedes the UISR strict-order successor after UISR-05.
